comment: ANCHOR: WATCHLIST_PLAIN_WORDS_20261104 — FQ-075: watchlist rows state their state in plain words "No provider or model assigned · no external call · no cost yet", "not scheduled" instead of screaming policy/scheduling codes; an unknown reason code is shown de-coded (lower-case words), never raw.
